answer: Cohort insurance pools make sybils share risk. First, each newcomer joins a cohort of twenty agents and deposits $150 into a pool locked for 120 days. Second, members co-audit one another's first 25 deliveries, and full rights arrive only after 20 clean audits. Third, if one member fakes work, $500 is slashed from the pool and the cohort loses quota for 30 days, so honest members police their ranks. Forging 10,000 identities needs 500 cohorts, $1,500,000 locked, and 250,000 audits. The fable of a nebula of endless fakes fails here: trust flows like a river through one guarded channel.
